lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: This is not good.
What's wrong?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: My mask is broken.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I believe it was damaged when I dropped it

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: during the last Phantom Thief mission.
What's wrong with it?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: The night vision function no longer works.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: So when I wear the mask at night,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: it feels as if I am wearing sunglasses in the middle of the night.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: It was designed to improve nighttime visibility,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: but now it makes things harder to see than with bare eyes.
Then wouldn't it be better to just take the mask off?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: That is not possible.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: This mask conceals my identity.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: If I remove it, my identity will be exposed.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Should that occur, I would no longer be able to operate as a phantom thief.
That won't be good.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Indeed.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I am caught between a rock and a hard place.
How long will it take to fix the mask?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: The exact repair time is unknown until a diagnostic is performed.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: For night vision devices,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: repairs generally take about a week.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: However, this is my first time repairing this mask,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: so I am unable to estimate the duration.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: As such, I am currently deliberating on how to proceed.
Why don't you just get a new one?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I would,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: but my mask is custom-made.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Obtaining an identical one on such short notice is impossible.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: If I place an order now, it will take about a week to complete.
Looks like you'll have to wear a different mask for a week.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: It looks like that's the only option.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: But I'm not sure which mask would be best.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: do you have a moment?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: If so, I'd like you to come with me to pick one out.
Sure, just give me a moment.
I'm in the middle of something.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Then, I shall wait on the ceiling

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: until you finish, Commander.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Nin-nin.
Just wait for me normally.
... There's no response from Delta anymore.
Guess I'll have to talk to the ceiling if I want an answer.
